'''Jan Mühlstein''' (born 3 July 1949) is a journalist, German Jewish activist and the former chair of the [[Union of Progressive Jews in Germany]].<ref>Süddeutsche Zeitung Nr.102, 4th Mai 2004, p. 4, see {{cite web |url=http://www.liberale-juden.de/cms/index.php?id=141&no_cache=1&tx_ttnews%5Bpointer%5D=4&tx_ttnews%5Btt_news%5D=47&tx_ttnews%5BbackPid%5D=95 |title=Union Progressiver Juden: Jan Mühlstein Vorsitzender der progressiven Juden in Deutschland PROFIL |accessdate=2011-08-01 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20110930130555/http://www.liberale-juden.de/cms/index.php?id=141&no_cache=1&tx_ttnews%5Bpointer%5D=4&tx_ttnews%5Btt_news%5D=47&tx_ttnews%5BbackPid%5D=95 |archivedate=30 September 2011 |df=dmy-all}}</ref>

== Life ==
Jan Mühlstein was born on 3 July 1949 in [[Most (city)|Most]], [[Czechoslovakia]]. He grew up in a German-speaking Jewish family, which traditionally practised Liberal Judaism. In 1967, he began studying physics at the [[Charles University]] in Prague. After the defeat of the reformation movement known as the [[Prague Spring]], in which Mühlstein participated actively, he immigrated to West Germany in 1969. From 1970 onwards, he studied physics at [[LMU Munich]] and completed a Ph.D. in theoretical quantum optics in 1977. During the next four years, he worked in the leadership of project energy research of the nuclear energy research facility in [[Jülich]].<ref>Zur Person. In: Jüdische Zeitung February 2006</ref><ref>Kurzvita auf energiemarkt-medien.de</ref> Since 1982, Mühlstein has been working as a business journalist in [[Munich]] and is deputy chief editor of a journal covering the economics of the energy market.

Between 1977 and 1978, Mühlstein was a board member of the West German section of [[Amnesty International]].<ref>Vereinsregisterblatt Nr. 5588 des Amtsgerichts Hamburg zu amnesty international Sektion der Bundesrepublik Deutschland e.V.</ref> He is a co-founder of the Liberal Jewish Community Munich "Beth Shalom", whose chair he was until 2005.<ref>Jan Mühlstein: 10 Jahre Beth Shalom. In: Beth Shalom Rundbrief 2/2005, p. 1f</ref> He was again elected as chair of Beth Shalom in May 2011. From 1999 until 2011, he was the chair of the [[Union of Progressive Jews in Germany]].<ref>Jan Mühlstein geht. Die liberale Dachorganisation wählt einen neuen Vorstand, Jüdische Allgemeine 7 July 2011; See also WUPJ News Issue 415 (http://www.wupj.org/Publications/Newsletter.asp?ContentID=439#SONJA {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111001234334/http://www.wupj.org/Publications/Newsletter.asp?ContentID=439#SONJA |date=1 October 2011 }})</ref> Mühlstein is particularly committed to promote religious plurality in [[Judaism]].<ref>Axel Fritzsche: "Wir brauchen flexible Rabbiner". Interview mit Jan Mühlstein, Vorsitzender der Union Progressiver Juden. In: Jüdische Zeitung February 2006</ref>

Mühlstein is married to Dr. Verena Mühlstein (born 1953), author of a biography about [[Albert Schweitzer]]'s wife, [[Helene Bresslau]],<ref>Verena Mühlstein: Helene Schweitzer Bresslau. Ein Leben für Lambarene. München: C.H. Beck, 1998</ref> who is also active at Beth Shalom. One of his three daughters works as a rabbi at the [[Liberal Synagogue "The Ark" in Northwood and Pinner]].<ref>url=https://www.arksynagogue.org/</ref>
